lines.t: Let your tears flow freely, let the spirit speak
Feel the gentle healing when you are weak
In the depths of mourning, grace starts to bloom
Breaking chains of sorrow, chasing out the gloom
Let your tears flow when the Spirit convicts you
Cleansing every part, making all things new
Open wide your heart, let Him do His work
And no more resist the cleansing of the Lord
Every drop of suffering
Every silent cry
Is a path to freedom
A way to fly
Let the bitter go
Let your soul be pure
In the light of his mercy
Find your sure cure
Let your tears flow
And the spirit convicts you
Cleansing every part, making all things new
Open wide your heart, let Him do His work
And no more resist the cleansing of the Lord
Break the walls of stubborn pride
Right in where truth resides
He who gave his life for thee
Calls you now to be set free
Let your tears flow when the spirit convicts you
Cleansing every part, making all things new
Open wide your heart, let Him do His work
And no more resist the cleansing of the Lord
Thank you.
